canonicalRequirements.statement: Promote, version and bind existing directional-lab DailyBarV1 without rebuilding it; eventTime is distinct from availableAt and availableAt >= eventTime.

Preserve missingness, raw-vs-adjusted separation, corporate-action policy, civilDate/marketCalendar, source registry/FREE fallback, replay manifests, and L4B macro vintage/revision semantics by wrap/import, not fork.
Required V1 sources have COST_CLASS=FREE; if no reliable free source exists mark UNAVAILABLE or OPTIONAL_FUTURE; do not introduce a paid mandatory dependency.
Reject lookahead, revision leakage, availability-time leakage and adjustment leakage; historical replay must not observe later vintages or future bars.
Define HISTORICAL vs LIVE boundary without implementing live production ingestion; keep historical precompute off the Wheel live-scan path.
New GATE21 artifacts resolve through PROJECT/DATA/CACHE roots; no new machine-home hardcodes; GATE21 ephemeral test roots use run-root-lifecycle.
Do not implement G22+ labels, features, regimes, UI, prediction, portfolio or live execution; do not mutate directional-lab source bytes unless a bounded mandatory defect is independently proven.
Preserve R0001 precontract evidence; this revision activates functional BUILD scope only and does not close, confirm, START, or authorize GATE22.

requiredOutputs.role: Canonical causal data facade for GATE22+
FREE source registry and fallback binding
Schema/version pins, HISTORICAL/LIVE and off-scan boundary

identical source version, manifest, cutoff, corporate-action policy and adjustment mode replay to the same digest

paid-only source configured as required V1

asserted PASS without consumer fixture consumption

reuseRules: REUSE then WRAP then CONTRACTUALIZE then VERSION; do not rewrite DailyBarV1 or L4B vintage modules.
Directional-lab bytes are INPUT/DEPENDENCY: read, import and wrap only unless a bounded mandatory defect is independently proven.
Reuse existing GEE/Fast Gate workflow, run-root-lifecycle and proof patterns without modifying their core.
Preserve EXECUTION_CONTRACT_R0001 bytes and START bindings; this revision does not replay START.
invalidationRules: Any mutation of EXECUTION_CONTRACT_R0001 invalidates this succession.
Any authorizedPath outside the exact BUILD cohort, or any wildcard/directory-wide path, invalidates this contract.
Any paid-only required V1 dependency invalidates this contract.
Any G22+ implementation or directional-lab source mutation without a separate proven defect invalidates this contract.
closureConditions: CLOSURE_PATH_PROOF recalculated from bound bytes, not asserted PASS.
Causality, vintage-hindsight, replay digest identity, leakage hostiles, FREE_DATA, portability, hygiene, no-production-coupling and evolvability are evidenced.
A declared consumer fixture fails if GATE21 v1 bindings disappear or mismatch.
This contract does not itself COMPLETE_AGENT, EXTERNAL_CONFIRM, or auto-authorize GATE22.
nextGateAuthorizationConditions: GATE21 BUILD PASS is not GATE22 authorization.
GATE22 requires a later separate execution contract and authority.
